rationale: Although price has pulled back below the $14.22 entry level as SPY weakened to -2.14%, the retracement has occurred on extremely light volume (4k–11k shares per minute compared to 203k on the breakout bar) and is currently testing support right at the rising 5m 9-EMA ($14.10).
